title: Assessing the Level of Toxicity Against Distinct Groups in Bangla Social Media Comments: A Comprehensive Investigation
reasoning: The research focuses on the classification of toxic speech targeting specific demographic groups (transgender, indigenous, and migrant people) using transformer-based models. While the paper mentions selecting annotators from diverse religious backgrounds to reduce bias and discusses the ethical implications of data collection, it does not evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, spiritual traditions, or moral/ethical frameworks.
